original.prompt: In February 2026, India's Ministry of External Affairs announced a three-day visit by French President Emmanuel Macron. Consider the following statements:
items: The India–France strategic partnership dates back to 1998.
Macron was scheduled to arrive in Mumbai to launch the India-France Year of Innovation.
The AI Impact Summit was scheduled to be held in Mumbai on 19 February 2026.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because Macron was to head from Mumbai to New Delhi for the AI Impact Summit on 19 February. France stayed a consistent partner even when India faced international sanctions, and the relationship rests on strategic autonomy.
original.source: Macron will arrive in Mumbai to launch the India-France Year of Innovation before heading to New Delhi for the AI Impact Summit on February 19
